# Call Window EU Grants

> EU funding calls open now, from Horizon Europe to Erasmus+, searchable by deadline, programme and type of action. Free, updated daily from the EU Funding & Tenders Portal.

Guides are researched from official sources, cite them, and are reviewed regularly.

## Data pages (rebuilt daily)
- [How to Apply for EU Funding: 6 Steps for First-Time Applicants](https://callwindowgrants.com/how-to-apply/): How to apply for EU funding calls: find a topic, read the conditions, get a free PIC, build a consortium and submit on the EU Funding & Tenders Portal.
- [EU Funding Calls Closing Soon (Oct 2026): Deadlines in the Next 30 Days](https://callwindowgrants.com/closing-soon/): Open EU funding calls with a deadline in the next 30 days, soonest first. Free, updated daily from the EU Funding & Tenders Portal (2026-10-25).
- [EU Funding Calls Open Now (Oct 2026): All Calls Open for Submission](https://callwindowgrants.com/open/): 202 EU funding calls open for submission now, sorted by deadline, with programme, budget and type of action. Updated daily (2026-10-25).
- [Forthcoming EU Funding Calls (2026): Calls Opening Soon](https://callwindowgrants.com/forthcoming/): 274 forthcoming EU funding calls with planned opening dates and deadlines. Plan your proposal early. Updated daily (2026-10-25).
- [EU Funding Calls by Programme](https://callwindowgrants.com/programme/): Open and upcoming EU funding calls by programme: Horizon Europe, Digital Europe, Creative Europe, CERV, the European Defence Fund and more.
- [EU Funding Calls by Type of Action](https://callwindowgrants.com/action/): EU funding calls grouped by type of action: research and innovation actions, innovation actions, coordination and support actions, lump sum grants…
- [EU Funding Calls by Deadline Month](https://callwindowgrants.com/deadline/): Open and upcoming EU funding calls grouped by the month of their next deadline. Plan proposals months ahead.
- [EU Funding Calls by Theme](https://callwindowgrants.com/topic/): EU funding calls by theme: SMEs and startups, artificial intelligence, climate, health, digital, energy, cybersecurity and more.

## About the data
- Source: [EU Funding & Tenders Portal (European Commission)](https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/)
- Licence: Reused under the Commission's reuse policy (Decision 2011/833/EU, CC BY 4.0); unofficial, not affiliated with the European Commission
- Updated once a day from the official public data. Unofficial; always confirm details on the official notice before applying or bidding.

## Guides
- [EU Funding and Tenders Portal Helpdesk: Ticket in 5 Steps](https://callwindowgrants.com/eu-funding-and-tenders-portal-helpdesk-ticket-in-5-steps/): How to use the EU Funding and Tenders Portal helpdesk: open an IT ticket in 5 steps, what to include, response times, and when to call your NCP instead.
- [EIC Pathfinder 2026: Deadlines, 3 Challenges & 7 Steps](https://callwindowgrants.com/eic-pathfinder-2026-deadlines-3-challenges-7-steps/): EIC Pathfinder 2026 explained. Open closed 12 May, Challenges close 28 October 2026, with a €262M budget, 3 topics, page limits and steps to submit.
- [EU Funding and Tenders Portal My Proposals: Status Table](https://callwindowgrants.com/eu-funding-and-tenders-portal-my-proposals-status-table/): What each status in EU Funding and Tenders Portal My Proposals means, where to find your ESR and result letters, and what to do next, with menu paths.
- [EU Funding and Tenders Portal Two Factor Authentication 2026](https://callwindowgrants.com/eu-funding-and-tenders-portal-two-factor-authentication-2026/): EU Funding and Tenders Portal two factor authentication setup: EU Login app, passkey and security key in 5 steps, plus lost-phone recovery and fixes for 2026.
- [HORIZON-HLTH-2027-02-TOOL-01-two-stage: Dates & Page Limits](https://callwindowgrants.com/horizon-hlth-2027-02-tool-01-two-stage-dates-page-limits/): HORIZON-HLTH-2027-02-TOOL-01-two-stage: 17 Feb and 16 Sep 2027 deadlines, 10- vs 40-page limits, scoring thresholds and portal steps for AI biomarkers.
- [Cascade Funding Open Calls: Portal Filters and 2026 Dates](https://callwindowgrants.com/cascade-funding-open-calls-portal-filters-and-2026-dates/): Find cascade funding open calls on the EU Funding & Tenders Portal: exact filter steps, the €60,000 FSTP cap, and key 2026 deadlines to track.
- [EIC Accelerator Deadlines: 2026 Cut-Off Dates and Steps](https://callwindowgrants.com/eic-accelerator-deadlines-2026-cut-off-dates-and-steps/): EIC Accelerator deadlines for 2026 explained: six full-proposal cut-offs, monthly short-application batches, draft 2027 dates, and the key steps to complete before the 4 November cut-off.
- [EU Funding and Tenders Portal Registration: PIC in 6 Steps](https://callwindowgrants.com/eu-funding-and-tenders-portal-registration-pic-in-6-steps/): EU Funding and Tenders Portal registration in 6 wizard steps: EU Login, PIC, validation documents, LEAR appointment and fixes for VAT errors.
- [EU Funding for SMEs: 7 Open 2026 Calls and How to Qualify](https://callwindowgrants.com/eu-funding-for-smes-7-open-2026-calls-and-how-to-qualify/): EU funding for SMEs in late 2026: 7 open calls from EIC Accelerator to Digital Europe, matched to company size and country, with eligibility steps to check before you apply.
- [Horizon Europe Proposal Template Part B: 2026 Scoring Map](https://callwindowgrants.com/horizon-europe-proposal-template-part-b-2026-scoring-map/): Horizon Europe proposal template Part B explained section by section, with the 40-page limit, what evaluators score, the 3.1 tables and common mistakes.
